item: Index window over the post-import re-index drain (row 407, R825)
summary: One exclusive drain run drops the 13 non-unique keyword and when/where/who indexes (ix_mention_article and the 3 unique stay) only when its backlog projects at least as many mention rows as the store holds (100%: on the real drain over 2.05M rows the window was 12.5% slower at 10%, 3.4% faster at 37% and 10% faster at 100% encrypted; plaintext 9.1% slower, 7.4% and 7.0% faster; the insert-only bench's 4% break-even did not survive extraction) and memory and disk were read and suffice, then rebuilds each once at its end with temp_store=MEMORY; a yield to an import leaves the marker for the next run; opening the store never rebuilds inline (a background heal does, at boot and after a restore); short memory keeps the marker and says so x12
